Episode 218. Structure where a stronger one comes when one falls (1)
January 2, 1804, one day after the new year began.

It was a new year when more articles were poured out than ever before. The transfer to the Demon World, each faction's response to it, the golden balloon of the Vamel Alliance, and the battle between Ayula and Zito.
The Saints under the protection of the Vamel Alliance were ecstatic about their activities that started simultaneously with the war.

It was definitely a joyous occasion, but it was also an enthusiasm to shake off the anxiety somehow. The Vamel Alliance had completed all areas in the first battle from various places, but the war with the Demon World was just beginning.

Until the Demon World is completely destroyed or surrenders, and until the final war with the great forces including Runcandel and Zipple ends. In the end, the Saints had no choice but to live with anxiety always.
However, those under the protection of the Vamel Alliance had relatively more hope than the civilians in other regions.
It was because Ayula left a word to Jin that he would trust and leave the rest to him after the battle with Zito.

-"The reason Zito has retreated now is because Jin Runcandel and Murakan are here. I inflicted irrevocable damage on Zito, the leader of the Demon World with my divine power, and I believe that Jin Runcandel will kill him and liberate us from the Demon World."
The words Ayula left before finishing his declaration. The content was being conveyed to the whole world by all the reporters present at the scene.
"I couldn't imagine Ayula being pushed back like that even once in over three thousand years of my life. Zito, that troublesome perverted guy is really strong."
"His light and vulgar speech is a symbol of the immortal Zito. Simple pain, pleasure from there. Zito is an entity that embodies that. Therefore, it is impossible to compromise or dialogue with him."
Zito was a different entity in many ways from the transcendent beings that Jin and his colleagues had met so far.
He didn't set the weight, and he didn't show off his divine power. His personality was more suited to a back alley thug than a transcendental being.

Still, Zito was a more dangerous entity than any transcendent being. All things and emotions in the world except pain and pleasure were worthless to him, and therefore there was no way to compromise in any way.
"Ha, I'm worried if Ayula is really okay. It seems like that Zito guy has exhausted a lot of Ayula's power."

"Murakan, why are you worrying about others all of a sudden. I haven't met him personally, but if he said he's fine, he should be fine. Of course, it will take a considerable amount of time to recover the lost divine power."
Ayula's divine power was not just exhausted from the battle with Zito. Ayula was already consuming his divine power when he cast a barrier over the entire kingdom.
Instead, as long as that barrier is not completely destroyed, it is expected to remain firm even after a thousand years.
"Ameris, has Ayula essentially lost his status in the hierarchy of the supreme gods?"

"It depends on how humans perceive the form of immortal beings. The barrier he created can be considered part of his physical body. Therefore, mortals of the Holy Kingdom who received Ayula's grace may feel closer to him. Actually, it is so. And the amplified faith through him will elevate him back to the highest immortal."
"That's good news... but it still feels strange. The necklace blessed by the dying lord was given to me and the kid in the end."
The Huhwasan necklace that Lani told Jin and Murakan to wear out of courtesy.
Ayula bestowed blessings on the two necklaces just before finishing his declaration.
"It's a blessing to protect the weakest among you at the decisive moment. He explained it like that, didn't he?"

"Indeed, he disappeared without explaining in more detail due to exhaustion. Hm, the weakest among us... then it's correct for the weak ones to have these necklaces. Let's see, who would be appropriate. One guy comes to mind immediately. Hey, Jet!"
"Yes, Murakan sir!"
"You take one."
"Haha, Murakan sir. Although I serve as an information source, I've also received quite a bit of training... Cough!"
Murakan blew Jet away with a punch. Jet held up both arms to block the attack, but he felt a pain as if his arm was broken.
Then Murakan swung his fist at the same speed at the other colleagues gathered in the conference room. No one was hit.
"You should accept it, right?"
"Ouch, of course. I just tried to say that because I was a bit burdened. The idea of me, of all people, possessing such a divine blessing seems a bit much."
"Take it. It's a great thing for the likes of you to have, but you've played a significant role since becoming a colleague. If you suddenly fall to the demon race, it would be upsetting for us."
Jet was deeply moved. He looked at Murakan with an almost tearful expression, and Murakan waved his hand in embarrassment.
"Yes! I will use it well. I'll take good care of it with all sincerity."
"Jet."
"Yes, sir!"
"Send the remaining one to Dr. Qwaul."
"Oh, that's right. It's right for Qwaul to have one. If something happens to him, our entire alliance's technological power will crumble."

Jet and Qwaul, thus, the two people who would possess Ayula's blessings were decided. Jin was swept up by the intuition that those necklaces would be of great help at the decisive moment to both of them, and the entire Vamel Alliance.
When Jet left, the colleagues fixed their gaze on the world map spread out on the table.
The map showed the points of the demonic world confirmed so far.
"Total of 79 transposed points... more than 80% of them are maritime."
The tips of the territorial waters of each force and neutral waters.

Most of the transposed cities, fortresses, and towns of the demonic world were formed there. The mainlands of the Vamel Alliance and the Lutero Federation were the results of each power blocking and defending against the transposition.
The transposed cities located within about 20% of each power's territory were the issues that needed to be addressed first.

The points of the demonic world formed within the territory boasted a much larger scale than most maritime cities. The size of the points was similar to the main cities of the human world, and the troops concentrated within them were incalculable.
"The demonic world's fortress formed in the Shol Juhu Kingdom was completely cleaned up by the storm balloons last night. Only one commander and about five officers escaped to other points."
"The Rainbow Birds and the Empire's investigation team are checking the interior of the demonic world's fortress. Probably a report will be up today."

The fortress of the Shol Juhu Kingdom, which was hit by the storm balloon, was the smallest in scale among the transposed cities formed in the inland. However, Jin had no intention of continuing to deploy storm balloons for inland cleanup.
"The primary role that storm balloons should perform is a barrier. If we use storm balloons for inland cleanup, the demonic world in the maritime area will aim to advance to the mainland."

Naturally, rumors about the power of the storm balloons were already circulating in the demonic world. Several demon generals had already been hit. The demonic world classified the storm balloons in the same grade as the aerial fortress that had trembled its prestige in ancient times.

"You're right, Jin. The moment their main force enters the inland, the alliance only has the option to defend. Plus, we have to fight while protecting civilians and territories, so we will keep being at a disadvantage."

"Yes. We have to establish a barrier over the entire maritime area of the demonic world centered on the storm balloons, and the rest of the troops need to directly suppress the inland. Bale and Amela, please check the necessary supplies and forces for the barrier in conjunction with the Golden Fleet and let me know. Those equipped with mobility and firepower suitable for mass destruction will primarily be deployed to the barrier."
"Yes, understood."
"Tch, understood."
"Thanks to Lady Ayula, Zito won't manifest again for a while, so they'll have to send their top fighters to break through that barrier."
However, if the top fighters of the demonic world were absent trying to break through the barrier, the alliance could then begin surprise infiltration.

Therefore, it wasn't a completely advantageous fight for the demonic world either. In the first place, the entire demonic world wasn't perfectly transposed to the ground, and Zito, who has the most overwhelming power, was in a situation where manifestation was impossible.

"When all the demonic world's bases in the inland are suppressed, we can start pressuring the demonic world from that point. Of course, to make this possible, we need to suppress them faster than the rate at which their bases are transposed to the inland."
Although the large-scale transposition had ended, the transposition itself was not over yet. Even now, each power was receiving real-time reports on the transposition fractures forming inland.

"Ultimately, the most ideal time of invasion for them would be when we're pouring all our efforts into cleaning up the inland. As we still don't know the full military force of the demonic world, we may have to redirect even the Golden Fleet inland."
"Either we finish suppressing the inland before that happens, or we manage to mass-produce the Golden Fleet... those are the best moves we can hope for."
"That's right."
Soon, Jin pointed to a fracture marked in the Shucheron Kingdom on the map.
"Firstly, this is the area that needs to be suppressed first. I will deploy Sir Tuben, Sir Heijin, and the execution knights from the families."
Next was the south of Delki.

"I will send Lady Mary, Brother Tona, and their subordinate forces to the relatively small southern part of Delki. Lady Luna and Lady Luntia, you should go to remove the fractures formed in the central and southern parts of the Empire respectively."
Those called nodded their heads. Following, Jin assigned areas to be suppressed to all the other transcendent beings in the alliance, including Hedo.

Fortunately, the number of transcendent beings was not less than the points of the demonic world formed in the inland of the alliance. Soon they will head to their respective missions and battles will commence simultaneously.

"Victory is important, but survival is even more so. Commanders, don't risk your lives for immediate victory, and if you feel you're being pushed back, retreat immediately and request support. Even if we lose and retreat in one area, everyone needs to survive to achieve overall victory."
The colleagues nodded their heads.
"But kid, why didn't you and I get assigned to the inland?"
When Murakan asked, Jin gave a thin smile.
"You and I will go to the sea to see what those who dared to invade the human world look like. Get ready, we're going."
